Karwa Chauth par ghar mein banayein Gulab Mathri aur Halwai Style Designer Mathri! 2 recipes, 1 video
Layers wali gulab mathri + halwai ki trick se design wali mathri. Poonam Devnani ki tried-and-tested recipe, Masala Kitchen par.
Gulab Mathri: saate se banti layers, ek-taar ki chashni aur kewra
Halwai trick: garam ghee-paani se maida gundhna, loi nahi, press karke belna
Bina saanche ke design wali mathri, chhalni mein tal kar na tute na bikhre
Bachi chashni se meethi mathri, varq-kesar-pista se sajayein
Comment karein — aapke yahan kis type ki mathri banti hai?
